title: dummyindex context features-list --json
description: Output of `dummyindex context features-list [--root DIR] --json` (new in the engine, not yet shipped). Wraps <root>/.context/features/INDEX.json; the GUI never reads INDEX.json directly. Item shape follows the INDEX.json style used by D:\Projects\dummyindex. CONSUMERS MUST CHECK schema_version FIRST: schema_version must equal 1 (the only version this contract defines). Any other value, or a missing value, is an EngineProtocol error and the features are not shown.

schema_version.description: schema_version-checked. Mirrors INDEX.json schema_version. A mismatch means the engine is newer or older than this contract.

root.description: Optional. Absolute repo root the list was read from.

feature_id.description: Stable kebab-case id. The GUI keys group frames on this value.

name.description: Display title. A group frame is titled exactly by this value.

confidence.description: Values observed in INDEX.json. Extend this enum only with a schema_version bump.

path.description: Feature folder relative to .context/, for example features/build-loop/.
